title: Handling base class deferral in Mypy plugin during import cycles
answers: Why does Mypy report unexpected keyword argument errors on a Pydantic subclass when there is an import cycle?
How does the Pydantic Mypy plugin handle circular imports between base and child models?
Why does the Mypy plugin fail to collect inherited fields from a base model during circular imports?
Why is Mypy crashing when two Pydantic models import each other?
body:
Symptom: Mypy crashes or reports false-positive unexpected keyword argument errors on model subclasses when models reference each other in an import cycle.
Root cause: pydantic/mypy.py:PydanticModelTransformer.collect_fields_and_class_vars skipped base classes whose processing was deferred in import cycles because METADATA_KEY was not yet populated, finalizing subclasses without inherited fields.
Fix pattern: Tag model TypeInfo metadata at start of transformation, detect tagged but incomplete base classes during ancestor inspection, and defer subclass processing via api.defer() for another pass.
Constraints: Applies to Mypy AST type-checking passes where class dependencies resolve out of order; deferral must check not api.final_iteration to prevent infinite analysis loops.
applies: Pydantic Mypy plugin model transformation when resolving base class fields across import cycles
